features.title: no_progress compares finding signatures, not verdict strings
features.acceptance: check_no_progress trips only when the auditor finding-signature SET is identical across threshold_rounds consecutive needs_changes rounds (using compute_audit_finding_signature, mirroring check_diminishing_returns). Different findings each round does NOT trip. Verdict-string equality alone no longer trips. supervisor.py call site passes the auditor envelopes (not bare verdict strings). Timeout-with-work carve-out preserved. Fallback (signatures unavailable) documented + tested.
steps: Read circuit_breakers.check_no_progress + check_diminishing_returns + the supervisor.py:~2493 call site.
Change check_no_progress signature to accept prior + current auditor envelopes (or findings lists); compute signature sets; trip only on identical persisted signatures.
Update supervisor call site to pass envelopes; keep timeout-with-work exclusion.
Preserve the reason-string contract for the stopped_no_progress terminal + classification sidecar.

features.title: latest-auditor-envelope selection is mtime/supersession aware
features.acceptance: signed_off_finalizer + closeout + closeout-memo auto-lift resolve the latest auditor envelope by mtime (or explicit supersession marker), not iteration index alone. A fresh i0 signed_off outranks a stale i1 needs_changes from a superseded run. latest_audit_status reflects the true latest verdict.
steps: Locate every 'latest auditor envelope' selection: closeout._latest_auditor_envelope, signed_off_finalizer, memo lift.
Switch ranking to mtime (or supersession sidecar) with index as tie-break.
Optionally have re-dispatch mark superseded envelopes.
Keep behavior identical when only one envelope per feature exists (the common case).

features.title: regression suite + full orchestrate sweep green
features.acceptance: Red/green tests: (a) no_progress does NOT trip when findings change across rounds with verdict held at needs_changes; DOES trip on identical findings; (b) finalizer picks fresher-by-mtime signed_off over stale higher-index needs_changes. Full existing orchestrate test sweep passes under raw pytest. Synthetic 3-round volley converges to signed_off instead of false stopped_no_progress at round 2.
steps: Write red tests for F001 (finding-set vs verdict-string) + F002 (mtime selection).
Full orchestrate sweep under raw pytest (env-isolated).
